note: EXAMPLE ONLY. Copy to config/ppe_policy.json and replace every entry with requirements set by the site's competent safety personnel under the rules and procedures that apply to the site. SafeSight never infers a PPE requirement from the image. Without this file every requirement is unconfigured: missing head protection is reported for review, never as a confirmed violation.

entries.basis: example: hard hats required in the loading area (to be confirmed by the site safety lead)

entries.note: camera ids are exact or '*'; 'pit-*' here is just a label and matches no camera until replaced
